# WP-PDR-28a A5 thermal closure: results

Run id `2026-09-29-a5-closure-r3`; runner `hardware/sim/thermal/a5_closure.py` on the unchanged `thermal_model.py` and `ts012_thermal.py` of the TS-012 thermal note (copies and SHA-256 below). Every temperature is an **estimate**.
